NCR Ventures 3 Things We Did Right Week Ending November 22, 2026 — Candles, Side Rooms, and a Chair Pulled Up
4 of 5
1
Pull Up a Chair
A chef came to the table to answer a menu question, then came back after the food landed to make sure it was right. A managing partner sat down with a table for a chat. A manager walked over on an anniversary with a card, a thank-you, and a slice of tiramisu. Guests remember who showed up.
2
Fix It, and Feed Them While You Do
A dish was not what the guest expected. The team fixed it with kindness, sent out a free appetizer while the kitchen remade it, and brought the plate back exactly as asked. The guest wrote that the care exceeded all expectations. That is a recovery done right.
3
Say Yes to the Seat
A table asked to sit away from a big group: done. A couple asked for the side room: problem solved, they wrote. A party of seven with a guest who struggles to be heard got the private room so he could join in. Guests waiting for a table were offered the lounge. The seat is the first yes.
NCR Ventures 3 Opportunities to Be Better Week Ending November 22, 2026 — Candles, Side Rooms, and a Chair Pulled Up
5 of 5
1
Someone Owns the Door
A table sat 45 minutes with only water, asked the host stand twice, and felt ridiculous for asking. A 3 PM walk-in waited at an empty host stand. An inside reservation was offered the patio or a 45-minute wait. Staff the stand every minute we are open. Greet in two. Honor the reservation.
2
Hot Food Hot, Pasta al Dente
Duck came out cold and the gratin undercooked on an anniversary. Profiteroles were stale, with syrup where ganache belongs. Lasagna arrived lukewarm. Pasta beside a very good chicken parm was mushy. A pizza came out raw, then burnt on the recook. Check temp and texture at the window.
3
Own the Miss
A regular asked for less spice and got a plate they could not eat. The server said she sent the note, then left it there. No apology, no remake, nothing off the check. A cloudy iced tea came back just as cloudy. When a plate misses, say sorry first, remake it right, and get a manager to the table.
Engage Souls. Be 1% Better. Keep it Fun. 🌷
